scope: Fresh static disassembly of installed official client ordinary native branches. Metadata names, signatures, field offsets, method-pointer tables and FP operators resolved. No game execution or runtime XLua override verification.

findings.claim: Effective natural SP rate is attribute 14 SP_RECOVERY_PER_SEC multiplied by attribute 30 SP_RECOVER_RATIO. Each attribute is independently resolved and clamped.
Natural recovery uses period 1/effectiveRate; SpController.OnTick skips timer updates when recovery is stopped or SP is full.
An existing valid timer is resized keeping elapsed absolute time: remainingNext=max(0,periodNext-(periodPrevious-remainingPrevious)), rather than preserving fractional progress.

Nonpositive effective rate marks timer invalid (-1 period and remaining); becoming positive with an invalid timer uses Reset(period,true), starting a full new period. This differs from blocking/full-state pause.
Normal SP modifier is rejected by SP_MODIFY_STOPPED (abnormal 29). If SP_RECOVER_STOPPED is present, only strictly negative finalDelta is applied. force=true bypasses both checks.
ModifySp has explicit _forceFlag at offset 0x24; Execute uses it as the default to a blackboard Boolean and passes the result to Entity.ApplyModifier.
Native TIME/ATTACK/HIT recovery uses SpController._RecoverMp, checks recovery stop unless forced, and directly sets owner SP without the modifier closure check.

Attack-source recovery is attached to the common attack-or-heal output notification. AbilityStandard.OnOutputAttackOrHeal forwards to Entity.OnOutputAttackOrHeal, which invokes buff output hooks and then the SP controller attack-source branch. EachSpell notifications are separate and do not themselves invoke SP recovery in Entity.
